workflow: Initial screen and context expansion, 80-item control audit, then complete own-text review of every remaining live reply. Every positive label checked against available reader context.

scale.0: No clear addressed sharpness under the rubric; includes ambiguous short reactions, shared jokes and external targets.
scale.1: Addressed derision, dismissive sarcasm, devaluation of the reader argument or scolding.
scale.2: Explicit personal abuse, humiliating comparisons or mockery of the reader mental/reading competence.

rubric_limits: Single subjective coding pass; emotional state and correctness of disputed claims not inferred. Four image-only/empty own-text replies remain in denominator but cannot supply text evidence.
